subject: SOC 2 Type II report + Trust Portal access - follow up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report + Trust Portal access - follow up

Hi Jordan — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Redwood scope: Hosted API for inference, enterprise tenancy (dedicated) option, standard data handling (customer data not used for training unless explicitly enabled).
- Your asks: confirmed need for SOC 2 Type II evidence, bridge letter during current reporting gap, and access to our Trust Portal for questionnaire uploads. Also you mentioned a vendor security questionnaire that your procurement team will send.

Next steps from our side:
1) I can grant Trust Portal view/upload access for your security contact — please confirm which email(s) to invite.
2) I attached our SOC 2 Type II bridge letter (PDF) for interim evidence and can upload the full SOC 2 Type II report to the portal once your SSO invite is accepted.
3) If you prefer, we can send the full report via a secure DocuSign/Share link instead of portal upload — let me know.

Would you like us to self-fill any part of your vendor security questionnaire once we get it? Happy to review and return within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Letter_2026.pdf
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + Trust Portal access - follow up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the bridge letter, received. A few clarifications from our InfoSec side before we provision portal accounts: 

- Does Redwood have any sub-service organizations (SSOs) documented in the SOC 2? We need a list for our mapping.
- What is your data retention policy for logs and request data for Hosted API customers?
- Can you confirm GDPR data processing addendum and whether you support Data Processing Agreements with standard EU SCCs?

We attached Acme's vendor security questionnaire (see attachment). Please have your security/ops SME review — we typically need the completed questionnaire and supporting artifacts (architecture diagram, data flow, and SOC 2 evidence) within 5 business days for new vendors.

Also — please invite security@acmehealth.com to the trust portal with upload privileges. Preferred contact for portal invites is security@acmehealth.com.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Health
Attachments: AcmeVendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Security <security@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + Trust Portal access - follow up

Jordan — thanks, and appreciate the questionnaire. Quick answers to your InfoSec bullets and plan to move forward: 

- Sub-service organizations: We do not currently rely on third-party processors that are in-scope as SSOs for SOC 2. Our SOC 2 report explicitly states our third-party vendor list; happy to surface the vendor inventory page from the portal.
- Data retention: default request logs (metadata + timestamps) are retained for 90 days for Hosted API customers; audit logs and billing data are retained for 13 months. We can discuss extended retention for Dedicated/Private deployments in the contract.
- GDPR/DPA: We offer a standard DPA that includes SCCs for EU customers and support custom DPA negotiations for enterprise agreements.

Portal invite: I created a Trust Portal account for Acme and sent an invite to security@acmehealth.com. Link below — once you accept I will upload the full SOC 2 Type II report and supporting artifacts (system architecture diagram, data flow, encryption details). If you prefer the PDF link instead, we can send via secure DocuSign link: https://app.redwoodinference.com/docusign/abc123

We started a draft of your vendor questionnaire — attached is the partially completed spreadsheet from our security team (we filled the administrative controls and referenced items we will attach in the portal). Neha (cc'd) will finalize the technical controls section and return the completed questionnaire within 48 hours.

Trust portal: https://trust.redwoodinference.com/portal/acmehealth

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Partial_AcmeVendor_Questionnaire.xlsx

Cc: Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + Trust Portal access - follow up

Marissa — portal invite came through and I was able to register with security@acmehealth.com. I can see the bridge letter already. A couple final items before we move to procurement: 

- Please upload the SOC 2 Type II report PDF and the system architecture diagram to the portal. We need both to complete the mapping.
- For the questionnaire: we will accept the partially completed version but need the technical controls completed by end of day Wednesday (5/10) to stay on our procurement timeline.

If you can confirm upload and the estimated time for the completed questionnaire (Neha/Marissa), I will flag procurement to prioritize the PR/PO.

Thanks — Jordan
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Health
